allocation_rule.planning_assumption_basis: v1: 276 of 384 fixed-fraction cells had Wilson width > 0.10 at n = 128 (recorded bundle); the true fraction for catalogue cells is an outcome of this campaign
allocation_rule.rejected_alternative: option B of the synthesis (40 designs x 2048 launches) was REJECTED; every design is kept
allocation_rule.saturation_meaning: Wilson width <= 0.10 at n = 128 holds iff p_hat is outside about (0.094, 0.906); the top-up therefore goes to the mixed cells whose labels are binomial-noise limited
allocation_rule.statement: two-stage frozen allocation: stage 1 integrates 128 scrambled-Sobol launches per catalogue cell for every design (one case per cell); stage 2 tops a cell up to 512 launches (three further 128-launch blocks, indices 16..63 of every stratum) iff the cell's stage-1 Wilson 95 % interval width for P(wall) exceeds 0.10; cells at or below the threshold are saturated and receive nothing; the rule is evaluated by code inside the single execution (per-design worker) and replayed by the main process from the endpoint terminations; no allocation decision is taken by a human after the counts are seen

control_rule.binding_gate: |P_wall,2N(control) - P_wall,N(control)| <= 0.02 POOLED over all control launches of all designs (paired over identical launches)
control_rule.fraction_rule: 1/8 of the cell's final launches (>= the 10 % of the synthesis); exact integers 16 and 64
control_rule.per_design_flag: timestep_passed := |Delta P| <= 0.02 on the design's own control subset (all its cells pooled, 48..320 launches); it is the orbit_mc convergence-evidence flag that decides sealing (as v1's N/2N check did) and is reported, never campaign-binding; the design's control quantum 1/n_control is recorded because one discordant orbit in a 48-launch control (0.0208) exceeds 0.02
control_rule.prior_expectation: v1 recorded 22 discordant orbits in 49,152 N/2N pairs (0.045 %)
reported: per design: n_control, discordant orbit count, P_N(control), P_2N(control), Delta P, quantum
campaign: pooled Delta P, pooled discordance rate, estimated N-vs-2N bias with its standard error
control_rule.seed_rule: numpy default_rng(first 8 bytes of sha256('<seed_namespace>:<design_key>:<cell_id>:control')).choice(n_cell, n_cell / 8, replace=False) over the cell's lexicographically sorted final launch keys
control_rule.statement: N -> 2N convergence control (MLMC logic): a frozen-seed random subset of one eighth of every cell's FINAL launches (16 of 128, 64 of 512; ceil(10 %) rounded up to the next power of two so that the control case sizes are Wilson-exact, see orbit_mc_contract.known_defect_v1_7) is re-integrated at the 2N time step; the paired difference of the wall-hit fraction over the same launches estimates the N-vs-2N bias of the reported N values
